o: It's almost Halloween.
Aren't you going to the festival?
Hey, why aren't you answering me properly?
I asked if you were going to the festival. What are you talking about?

chat.t: I don't know what I'll do.

o: Oho.

chat.t: All the Corrupting Power that built up inside me...

o: Then that's bad.
Send me your location.

chat.t: But I was happy you came to see me.

o: If you ever need my help, call me anytime.

chat.t: But what I need isn't help...

o: Not help?

chat.t: Aberrant Spirits are extremely dangerous creatures.
Even if I'm suppressing it, if you approach me so defenselessly...
You really might end up getting devoured.

o: Do I look that delicious to you?
What do I even taste like?

lines.t: I searched all the places Kouchou might be, but there was no sign of her.
Just then...
Is that... a butterfly?
Shrine
A Red Butterfly appeared.
As if beckoning me to follow...
It fluttered slowly toward the shrine grounds, then vanished.
And then...
I'm here!
!? Y-You...
Did you think I'd just sit still after hearing that?
I-I... didn't mean it like that.
How did you find this place?
...Don't look at me.
The butterflies guided me. Saying, "Over here!"
I see. The butterflies are influenced by my heart...
A mistake. If I knew this would happen, I should have suppressed it... more.
But what's with those horns?
This is... the influence manifesting.
Influence?
Halloween is the day the boundary with the netherworld dissolves.
The Corrupting Power I took in while fighting Aberrant Spirits all this time...
That power is consuming me.
A cosplay thing?
No.
Is it contagious?
Not that either.
What, then it's no big deal.
...(Twitch)
Corrupting Power attracts Aberrant Spirits and gradually warps its surroundings.
My powers as a shrine maiden... The power of the Red Butterflies can suppress the effects, but not completely.
Specifically?
...Hah.
I lose control of my emotions like this.
Gah!?
Your breath, your scent, every single word you say...
It stimulates something inside me... dredging it up...
Haa... I want to taste you.
Me?
Yes. From head to toe... every last bit... even every single one of your fingers...
This is why I told you not to come...
I'm spending all my strength suppressing the Corrupting Power, so I can't control my actions.
Do you really need to control yourself?
What?
Just do whatever your heart desires.
Are you serious?
If you see my true self... If you see how selfish I am...
You'll definitely come to hate me.
That's ridiculous. There's no way I'd be disappointed in you.
But you know...
...Why?
That Corrupting Power basically makes you more honest than usual, right?
Yes. It warps my emotions and heart... making it impossible to restrain myself like usual.
Which means... you've wanted to get closer to me all along, haven't you?
You should've just told me sooner.
N-No... but... this power is dangerous...
The power of the Red Butterflies within me attracts Aberrant Spirits.
That's why I've kept my distance, so this power wouldn't hurt anyone else.
You're so kind.
Kind...?
No, I... That wasn't my intention.
It was because I was afraid of getting hurt.
Because I was scared that other people would get hurt because of me.
That's why even now... I'm terrified.
That you might get hurt because of me...
Go ahead.
Try hurting me.
W-What?!
Why worry so much about things that haven't even happened?
I'm a lot tougher than you think, you know? Go ahead, try and hurt me all you want.
Ugh...
If that puts your mind at ease... well, that works for me.
...Please leave.
Huh?
I don't want to hear any more.
So go back. Hurry...
Hurry...!
The energy emanating from Kouchou was clearly abnormal, so I decided to back off for now.

chat.t: By the way... did you know about the Quartet Festival?

o: Of course I do.

chat.t: It has the effect of suppressing Corrupting Power.

o: Then isn't it actually great for you right now?
Why?
She's just socially awkward!
I'll show you what a real festival is like, so come on out.

lines.t: Festival Street (Night Market)
Did you wait long?
No.
When did you get here?
Six hours ago.
Did I tell you the wrong time...?!
No, it's not that.
My heart was pounding and I just couldn't sit still, so...
I just came out early.
Is that from the Corrupting Power too?
Maybe, maybe not.
What the heck, don't leave me hanging like that.
Anyway, let's enjoy the festival like we promised.
Step right up!
Welcome to the test of strength!
Test of strength?
Prove the muscles you've honed right here!
Hit the punch machine and beat our record to win a special prize!
A punch machine, huh... That won't be easy.
It's easy, though...
Huh? What did you say?
No, nothing...
What's this? Are you chickening out?
Doesn't look like you work out much either. Haha!
...Phew.
WHAM!
Were you always this strong?
The boundaries are blurred within me right now, after all.
But what about the record?
That's hardly what matters right now, is it?!
This isn't breaking a record... You broke the machine's entire lifespan!
Should I... apologize for this?
An apology isn't going to cut it!
Pay for it! Pay up!
Um... can we just call it a draw?
A draw, my foot! We haven't even finished paying the installments on this!
Aaargh! We're gonna have to live on cheap protein shakes for a while again!
Pay for it...
There's a great solution for times like this.
A great solution...?
RUN!
I grabbed Kouchou's hand and sprinted away from the scene.
That was a close one.
Yeah.
...Pfft.
Sorry. But this whole situation is... strangely hilarious.
I belong to the Fairwinds Association, who protects the festival, but I've hardly ever enjoyed it myself.
Because my power, and my heart... never permitted it.
But being at this festival with you feels so fun, like I'm dreaming.
Yes. Just like a sweet dream that will vanish into thin air in an instant...
There you go talking nonsense again.
I'm not some dream. I'm right here, right now.
We're holding hands, so you know it, don't you?
Ouch, hey, hey! That's way too tight.
What... is this emotion?
Something burning, unlike anything I've ever felt... is rising up from deep inside my chest.
What on earth... is this sensation?!
W-Wait. Calm down!
Ugh... Ngh...!
What is this?!
The Aberrant Spirits... they're crossing the boundary.
We need to get away from here right now... Hurry...!
Deep in the Mountains
Now I understand. Why I couldn't suppress this.
It's because of you.
...Can I request an attorney?
...I'm not blaming you.
Before I met you, I was a tranquil pond.
Stagnant deep within the mountains, unvarying, and never flowing.
But after meeting you, I became... a rippling lake, a flowing river, a raging sea.
Just as a caterpillar transforms into a butterfly through a cocoon.
You changed me, <:player>.
So... this flow cannot be stopped the old way.
Then what are we supposed to do?
...That... we'll have to find out.

o: No, I'm right behind you.
You actually believed that? How naive.
More importantly, did you send these butterflies?
Yup.
They won't even flee when I spray bug spray.

chat.t: They're spiritual entities, so that won't work on them.

o: I don't dislike them, but...
Even a cute polar bear would suck if it were inside your house.

chat.t: The butterflies symbolize my heart, though.
Make sure you don't wander outside tonight.
And keep your doors and windows shut tight.

o: What is this, advance notice of a crime?

lines.t: Inside the Quartet Room
It was a strange night.
I felt an odd heat, and my body was burning up.
And a hazy feeling enveloped me, almost as if I were in a dream.
Feeling as if I were awake, yet not truly awake.
I tried to shut the door and get some sleep just as Kouchou warned, but...
It's way too hot... Airing the place out for just a bit should be fine.
The moment I opened the door...
!? W-What?
Kou...chou?
Whoa, you scared me. You could've at least said something if you were coming.
...I warned you.
Warned me?
Yes.
You shouldn't have opened the door.
A door is... a "boundary." Separating this side from that side.
The moment you opened it, the boundary broke down and began to intermingle.
Dreams and reality, thoughts and imagination.
If you hadn't opened the door, I might have barely held on, but...
Ah... Now, it's impossible.
Does that mean...
It's your fault. Because you refused to leave me alone in the first place.
These emotions, this heart. Feelings I should never have possessed to begin with...
So now... I have no choice but to do it with you.
Do what?!
That's...
Haa...
Training to suppress the Corrupting Power, of course.
Aha, I see!
...And here I already pulled my pants down.
...? Why your pants?
Well, uh... You know, a physical something, or a biological something.
...Regardless, right now I'm suppressing both my power and my emotions at the same time.
But with your help... venting these emotions will allow me to control my power.
Then it will be easier to purify the Corrupting Power.
In other words...
You're going to unleash all your honest feelings on me, right?
Yes.
That doesn't sound half bad.
Seeing that side of you has plenty of value, too.
Don't regret it.
Because once we start, I definitely won't be able to stop halfway through...
That's my line.
Gah!?
...I told you. Not to regret it.
Inside the Quartet Room
Phew, haa...
It's calming down... bit by bit...
What, over already?
Yes. If it's only this much, I can manage on my own...
That's not right.
That's not what you're supposed to say.
How did it feel to express your true feelings so honestly?
It felt... good.
I was happy.
Because I've never honestly revealed what was in my heart before.
So?
Are you just going to go back to how things were?
Saying, "Ah, that was a wonderful one-night memory"?
Going right back... to being all alone in the past?
I... don't want that.
Then what should you say?
<:player>.
The Corrupting Power built up inside me... will change me yet again.
Into someone selfish, someone who hurts you.
Are you still okay with that?
Of course I am!
All right, then...
So that I can suppress this power, and so that I can remain myself...
Help me, <:player>.
Well then, first we'll have to enjoy the festival together again.
What, didn't you say the festive atmosphere helps you?
Then we ought to go out more often, right?
Hmm...
Try being a little more honest with yourself.
That should help vent those feelings of yours a bit more.
...Yeah.

chat.t: You promised we'd go to the festival.

o: Nah.
I'm just a bit busy right now.

chat.t: You're in your room watching dirty stuff, aren't you?

o: You said you wouldn't use your butterflies as CCTV!
Look at you, learning tricks like that.

chat.t: So are you coming to the festival or not?

o: Let's go.
You're the one who wanted it.

chat.t: I'm going to do it too.

o: That was strictly by mutual consent...
...Look who can make jokes now.

chat.t: Might I have finally become a proper shrine maiden.
Can you feel it? My feelings through the butterfly...

o: ...Yeah.

chat.t: Feel them. My emotions, my senses, my heart.
Because I'll be feeling you, too.

o: Don't just leave without me.

chat.t: If you keep teasing me like that...
I might just eat you up.

o: Go ahead and try.

chat.t: Just you wait until next time.

o: I'll be looking forward to it.

lines.t: Festival Street (Night Market)
Have you been waiting long?
No.
When did you get here?
...Maybe thirty minutes ago.
Ooooh!
What's with that reaction?
Nothing, just thought there's been some kind of change, is all.
Anyway, let's get going.
Welcome! This is the Panoticon stall!
Experience Panoticon's services at an affordable price!
Panoticon? Why prison services of all things out here...?
That's right! The Head Maid ordered us to come promote Panoticon!
...Huh?
So you're telling people to come experience a five-star hotel prison?
Yes!
...How much is it?
Just about this much!
Ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, ten thousands, hundred thousands, millions...
Are you out of your minds?! It's free if you get actually arrested!! How on earth is this affordable?!
Hey now, you have to pay here, Master!
Still, it's cheaper than an actual five-star hotel!
It's not like money grows on trees for us, after all!
Forget it. Not interested. I've already seen, experienced, and tasted all of it...
Wait! Now that I look closer, y-you're...
The legendary person who overpowered the Head Maid, turned her into a chair, and went slap slap on her butt...?!
You did something like that...?
Wait. That's a misunderstanding!
Ever since that day, the "Chair Slap Slap" was added to the Head Maid's punishment menu!
Take responsibility! She did it to me yesterday, too!
Gah...
A chair... slap slap...
I've never tried that... I'm curious...
Hello? Kouchou???
Heeh, is that so? Guess you've never had a palm slap slap before!
That's our weekly routine!
Hey, what are you even bragging about?
And Kouchou, don't get competitive over weird things like that...
You told me to be honest with myself.
Huh?
So I'm going to be honest.
...I'm curious.
Wow, I didn't see this coming.
I said be honest, not awaken to a brand-new kink...
Are you disappointed?
No! Not that!
Fine. It's fine. It's all good, but...
Does it really... have to be here?
Yes.
Right in the middle of a festival with people watching?
And specifically inside a Panoticon prison experience booth?
Dammit! If you put it like that, how can I say no?!
Master stepping right in!
Time for the Panoticon Guard and Inmate Experience!
Now then, Master, please give us a line fitting your role!!
A-A line?
Yes! Immersing yourself in the role is very important!
You wouldn't half-ass it after paying good money, would you?  Pffft!
Gah...! Why you little...!
I'm fine with it, so go ahead, <:player>.
<:player>...?
Who do you think you're ordering around, you naughty masochist shrine maiden!
Huh?! How dare a mere prisoner boss Master around?!
A-Ah!
W-Whoa... Ruthless... Totally merciless...
So that's the rumored Conqueror of Panoticon... A beast in human clothing, an absolute lecher...
Who are you calling a lecher, you damn maids!
Ngh?! W-Why me...?!
Collective responsibility, you butt!
Panoticon
Achoo!
...Hm? Why are my ears burning all of a sudden... Is someone talking behind my back?
Well, whatever. I can always just spank their butt and call it a day.
Haah...?!
Say thank you for the punishment!
Th-Thank you for the p-punishment...?
Having such a luscious butt, how insolent! Do you admit your crime or not!
I-I was wrong...?
Who told you to talk back!
Ahh?! Y-You're the one who asked...
Hmm? A mere butt daring to make excuses? How insolent!
Now... tell the truth. Who were you thinking of?
Who were you thinking about last night?!
Th-That's...
I-I was thinking of you...
O-Oh.
S-Speak up properly!
I-I was thinking of you...!
Good, loud and clear! You pass!
Hey, maids! Get a bandage for this butt over here.
R-Right away! One Panoticon Special Bandage, coming right up!
Thank you for your patronage!
Hey.
Let's... come again.
...Yeah.
But hey.
Next time... let's do this where there are no people around...
Well... it's not that I disliked it, it's just a bit embarrassing. Just a bit.

chat.t: As the blurred boundaries grow clear,
And butterflies take flight above the tranquil waters,

o: Arise, warrior of the Red Butterfly.
No, it just sounded like song lyrics.

chat.t: Anyway, I'll send you the location, so meet me there.
There's something I need to ask of you.

o: It might take a bit. I'm in the middle of something.

chat.t: You're just watching lewd stuff in your room.

o: Stop.
Cut it out with the butterfly CCTV.

chat.t: I can't even control that myself.
If you want it to stop, help me sort things out here first.

o: Dammit, fine, I'm coming.

chat.t: I have the Corrupting Power completely under control.
What happened last time won't happen again.

o: That's a shame.
I actually liked watching you beg, saying you couldn't take it anymore.
Really? Guess the new tools I bought won't be needed then?
Did you or did you not?
Good girl.

chat.t: You're a worse person than I thought.

o: Do you hate that?

lines.t: Shrine
This place is...
The place where the ritual will be held.
A ritual?
Yes. Like I said before, suppressing it won't solve anything for me right now.
So... I'm going to draw out the drive deep within my heart alongside the Corrupting Power and purify them together.
That's why...
I need you.
Specifically, what do you need me to do?
It's simple.
Even if my emotions overflow, even if my heart spills over, so that I don't collapse...
Guide me so that I can stay myself.
This is... something only you can do, <:player>.
Can't say no to that. But specifically, what am I supposed to do?
You told me the objective, but you haven't told me what actions to take.
That... you'll find out naturally.
And there's one condition.
A condition?
Yes. A condition necessary for both you and me.
If you break it, there's no telling what might happen to either of us.
Enough suspense, just spit it out.
Do you really think I'd back out after coming this far?
Heheh, you're... right, you always were that kind of person.
The condition is... never stop.
No matter what I say,
No matter what face I make.
Until the very end—don't stop.
Even if you beg?
Even if I beg.
You better not regret it.
Same to you.
Hahaha!
Pfft...
Then I'll head inside first.
I'll leave the barrier open, so...
Once you're prepared, come inside.
Can I take my time?
Suit yourself. But...
If you're too late, seriously... I might not be able to come back.
Shrine
Phew...
Post-nut clarity?
No.
No, actually, you're half-right.
The emotions are still there, but they don't overflow anymore. Almost like...
The vessel holding the water became wider.
Still, to think spanking butts at the festival would lead to this...
You really never know what life has in store.
Pfft... Right. I agree.
So. How do you feel?
Like a craftsman gently shaping a vessel with tender hands...
You reshaped me, <:player>.
Just as you desired, with your own hands, into the shape you wanted...
I feel like I've been reborn.
...Did I really do something that amazing?
Yes.
So that I could stay myself.
Because you kept me from succumbing to the Corrupting Power.
And...
Because you let me experience things I had never experienced before.
Though... it did hurt a little...
Remind me, who was the one telling me not to stop midway through?
Th-That was...
Want to do it again?
...Yes.
As long as <:player> is fine with it...
